instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Specialty coffee and gourmet food retailer with 6 physical locations and a growing e-commerce channel. Roast our own beans in-house and curate 200+ artisanal products. Seeking to unify inventory across physical and online channels and implement a subscription-based loyalty program. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. Our current portfolio includes 4 active projects across new business models, digital products, and operational AI use cases. One incubated project has already graduated to become a standalone business unit.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next 2 years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount — we want to do more with our existing team.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 6 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Multi-Channel Inventory Unification and Visibility Platform
opportunities.rationale: The core business challenge is unifying inventory data across 6 physical locations and the e-commerce channel. This platform is critical to supporting a single source of truth for stock levels, preventing overselling, and optimizing stock deployment based on demand signals.

first_actions: Audit current Point-of-Sale (POS) system integration points with the e-commerce backend.
Map existing inventory data flow from warehouse/receiving to retail floor display.
Identify a cloud-based Inventory Management System (IMS) that supports multi-location tracking.
resources_needed: IT consultant specializing in POS integration
Internal operational staff time (for process mapping)
SaaS subscription budget for IMS pilot
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in stock discrepancies (<2% variance) and cycle count completion rate.
milestones: Pilot integration testing with 2 key locations successful
Live rollout of standardized inventory tracking protocol

opportunities.title: End-to-End Operational Workflow Automation (RPA Focus)
opportunities.rationale: To achieve the 15% OpEx reduction goal, manual processes like order processing, invoicing, and basic customer support need automation. Focusing on Robotic Process Automation (RPA) provides high ROI improvements with relatively low technical risk for a company of this size.

first_actions: Conduct process mining workshops to identify the top 3 most time-consuming, manual tasks (e.g., cross-referencing invoices/orders).
Design and prototype an RPA solution for a low-risk area (e.g., nightly invoicing reconciliation).
Measure current cycle time vs. projected automated cycle time.
resources_needed: Business analyst specializing in process mapping
Dedicated subject matter expert (SME) from finance/ops
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of manual touchpoints or FTE hours spent on target processes (e.g., 20% reduction in invoice processing time).
milestones: Top 3 process candidates prioritized and mapped
Successful pilot automation launch (Scope: one specific function)
Documentation of optimized, automated SOPs for the team

next_steps.action: Formalize a Scope Definition Document for the OpEx automation project (opp_3), detailing the process boundaries, inputs, and desired outputs.
Issue RFPs to potential IMS vendors, specifically requesting modules for multi-location inventory and e-commerce integration.
Hold a cross-functional workshop to prioritize the next strategic business unit development area, ensuring alignment with OpEx reduction goals.

key_weaknesses: Founder bottleneck: Over-reliance on founder for product/tech decisions limits parallel innovation streams and execution speed.
Talent limitation: The lack of a formal engineering team forces heavy reliance on expensive, project-based contractors.
Process clarity gap: While operational efficiency is the goal, the specific ROI prioritization across all 6 store workflows remains generalized.

improvements: Increased digital maturity (from 3 to 4), indicating greater internal capacity and system adoption.
Increased allocated budget percentage for innovation (3% to 8%), suggesting a higher organizational commitment despite the micro-business size.
persistent_gaps: The strategic shift from general efficiency goals to specific, measurable automation targets needs defined ownership.
Internal process documentation remains fragmented across multiple systems and manual workflows.
achieved_milestones: Successfully launched the inventory digitalization project, establishing a cross-functional focus on data unification.
Established a clearer mandate to reduce OpEx by 15%, providing concrete targets for automation efforts.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant operational focus shift towards concrete OpEx reduction targets and automation potential (RPA/IMS). Digital maturity improved due to the launch of major inventory digitalization efforts.
